matching.advancedPanel: Expose advanced plus optionally individual allTextNodes for precise per-line edits. Every original text node is reachable.

implementationNotes: Annotate cloned SVG text and image nodes before mutation; never depend on node order after creating tspans/newlines/images.
Keep Cairo embedded in exports and await document.fonts.ready before measuring, previewing, or exporting.
box is a safe editing allocation, not original glyph bounds. Core may flatten x/y/width/height.

Respect explicit line breaks, wrap by measured Arabic word widths, and shrink down to minFontSize. If text still overflows, report overflow in the form and preserve all content; never silently truncate.
Grouped textarea ids preserve per-node fill/stroke style. Existing outlined text has background fill, paint-order stroke fill, stroke width5.5; do not make its fill transparent.
Nested ballot fields use parent coordinates with existing ancestor transforms. Do not rewrite them into canvas coordinates or discard the rotation.
For slots with one existing text node but maxLines2, reuse first node and create matching cloned nodes/tspans only in the edited copy.
Portrait clipPath is already present and should stay fixed; pan/zoom the image inside the slot rather than moving the slot.
Raster uploads should be embedded as data URLs. SVG exports must embed uploads/font and retain transparency; PNG uses source dimensions.
Party logos inside flags/box are nested svg path vectors, not text nor raster image upload slots.
All caption/source/date fields contain user-editable content; no automatic factual updates should be inferred by editing the design.
